cds.title: Illinois State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, ISU ReD repository)

navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Illinois State University (campus setting: Suburb: Midsize)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025; residency split excludes 37 applicants / 29 admits of unknown residency). International: 345 of 382 admitted (90%). No waitlist; no early decision or early action. Undergrad enrollment is B1 total undergraduates (19,513); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident total (165). SAT composite 25/50/75 = 1000/1110/1210. GPA distribution is the 'all enrolled students' column. The university reports the middle 50% GPA of admitted fall 2026 freshmen as 3.29-4.05 (self-reported).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8: standardized test scores are not required; applicants may submit an ACT or SAT score and it cannot affect their standing negatively.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (first-year, 2026-27): required fees ($4,146.30) include student health insurance, automatically charged at 9+ credit hours and waivable with proof of insurance. Tuition varies by program for about 30% of undergraduates. Transportation estimate $2,452 not included in other_usd. The CDS H6 nonresident-aid section was left blank.
